# LessonPair

> Open-source English video learning skill and ChatGPT/Codex plugin: first attempt, targeted practice, learner retry, evidence-based comparison, and later recall. Includes a local tutor for user-configured compatible AI endpoints. Notion is optional.

This is a project-specific index at https://sjskoko.github.io/lesson-pair/llms.txt. It is a navigation aid for direct retrieval, not a crawler-control file or an automatic installation mechanism.

## Start here
- [English overview](https://sjskoko.github.io/lesson-pair/): purpose, fictional demo, workflow, and FAQ.
- [한국어 소개](https://sjskoko.github.io/lesson-pair/ko/): 영어 영상 학습 스킬·플러그인 소개와 가상 예시.
- [Installation guide](https://sjskoko.github.io/lesson-pair/guide/): plugin installation, portable AI use, local model connection, privacy.
- [한국어 설치 가이드](https://sjskoko.github.io/lesson-pair/ko/guide/): 플러그인 설치·내 AI 연결·개인 기록.
- [Repository](https://github.com/sjskoko/lesson-pair): canonical source and contributions.

## Skill source (read progressively)
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjskoko/lesson-pair/main/skills/lesson-pair/SKILL.md): entry point and workflow selection.
- [Guided session](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjskoko/lesson-pair/main/skills/lesson-pair/references/guided-session.md): one-question tutoring and learner-owned before/after.
- [Source access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjskoko/lesson-pair/main/skills/lesson-pair/references/source-access.md): captions, excerpts, and missing-source behavior.
- [Own AI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjskoko/lesson-pair/main/skills/lesson-pair/references/own-ai.md): endpoint configuration, controls, privacy and costs.
- [Plugin setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjskoko/lesson-pair/main/docs/plugin.md): repository marketplace and actual distribution status.
- [Notion workflow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjskoko/lesson-pair/main/skills/lesson-pair/references/notion-workflow.md): setup, writes, idempotence, verification.
- [Page templates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjskoko/lesson-pair/main/skills/lesson-pair/references/page-templates.md): preparation and review page structure.
- [Python formatter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjskoko/lesson-pair/main/skills/lesson-pair/scripts/lesson_pair.py): render supplied JSON; check Notion table markup.

## Examples and project facts
- [Synthetic input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjskoko/lesson-pair/main/examples/lesson.synthetic.json): fictional material, never a real learner record.
- [Clickable demo](https://github.com/sjskoko/lesson-pair/blob/main/examples/guided-demo.md): a fictional guided learning conversation on GitHub.
- [Plain-text reference bundle](https://sjskoko.github.io/lesson-pair/llms-full.txt): overview, installation, and skill references in one file.
- [Project metadata](https://sjskoko.github.io/lesson-pair/project.json): stable URLs, requirements, license, and limitations.
- [MIT license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjskoko/lesson-pair/main/LICENSE)

AI execution still uses model tokens and the host's limits. Private Notion writes require an authorized connection. The local formatter has no network calls, telemetry, or automatic language correction. Missing transcripts, meaning, scores, or completion must not be invented. Public examples are synthetic.
